children: Dubai-based Azizi Developments will launch a 30 billion UAE dirham ($8.17 billion) freehold master-planned community in Sharjah on Thursday with more than 10,000 residential units.
Azizi Florence, its first project in the emirate, will house 1,130 villas, more than 6,000 townhouses and 3,500 apartments, the developer said in a statement.
Centered around a 1.7-million-square-foot Central Park, the six residential clusters will each feature a park, clubhouse, community center and landscaped gardens.
The company is returning to Sharjah after more than three decades, said Mirwais Azizi, Founder and Chairman of Azizi Group.
The developer has delivered more than 45,000 homes and currently has approximately 150,000 units under construction.

title: Dubai developer Azizi enters Sharjah with $8bln master community
